title: Strict scalar tensor towers respect coefficient composition
statement: For finite coefficient extensions E to L to F over Q_l, every scheme W and arbitrary completed E-module cochain complexes P,Q, let a,b,c be the strict tensor tower comparisons of [lem-pur-integral-scalar-finite-comparison-models] for i,j,ji, with b followed by the F-tensor tower functor on the two scalar associators of [lem-weil-scalar-extension-composition]. Then whiskerRight(a,S_j);b = whiskerLeft(Tower_E(P,Q),kappa);c as natural transformations of strict inverse sequences of complexes. This is an equation of strict tower maps before applying the Roos construction.

source.place: Tensor reassociation, evaluation and coefficient comparisons; scalar-comparison proof step 9 of lem-pur-integral-operations-scalar-extension; Stacks 03EL, 07A4, 08J9 and 08TC.

proof.text: Apply NatTrans.ext. At n the chosen tower normalization identifies its component with the normalized finite comparison. The tensor tower functor component is the finite tensor functor. Apply the finite-level composition equation to this component. No claim that scalar extension preserves products is used.

theorem integralScalarTensorTowerComposition (W : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u})
    (P Q : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E W) ℤ) :
    Functor.whiskerRight ((scalarTensorTower l E L ι W).app (P, Q))
        ((integralOrdinaryScalar l L F j W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)) ≫
      ((scalarTensorTower l L F j W).app
          ((((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P),
            (((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q)) ≫
        (integralOperationsTensorTowerFunctor l F W).map (CategoryTheory.Prod.mkHom
          ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (integralOrdinaryScalarComp l E L ι W F j)
            (.up ℤ)).hom.app P)
          ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (integralOrdinaryScalarComp l E L ι W F j)
            (.up ℤ)).hom.app Q))) =
    Functor.whiskerLeft ((integralOperationsTensorTowerFunctor l E W).obj (P, Q))
        (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (integralOrdinaryScalarComp l E L ι W F j)
          (.up ℤ)).hom ≫
      (scalarTensorTower l E F (j.comp ι) W).app (P, Q)
